objective: Test whether forcing the projected carrier and recurrent controller to use the same projected slot address yields a bounded RWKV vector-FiLM hybrid with exact zero-state identity and material row/layer sensitivity.

authorization_basis.diagnosis: The independently routed aligned recurrent controller changed native outputs but did not select the correct row or layer, and stronger teacher-forced contrast did not transfer to generation.
authorization_basis.response: Use the projected carrier route to address the matching RWKV state slot, retain the projected value as material carrier, and use only the addressed recurrent read as a bounded vector-FiLM controller.

architecture.addressing: Use the projected K/V slot route to select and mix the corresponding RWKV recurrent state slots; bypass the independent RWKV route.
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent state produces a zero addressed recurrent read and zero modulation, so fusion is exactly projected-only.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.correct_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct-row recurrent state addressed by the projected route.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus zero recurrent state.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus a deterministic different-gold, length-matched donor recurrent state addressed by the correct projected route.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct recurrence cyclically moved across all 42 wrapped layers.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked 16-update specificity-focused causal training run with a new source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and do not train this equation.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim only BF16-visible structural sensitivity to correct row and layer under fresh initialization.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later causal training and a separately locked native generation result.
